[EN] You vanquish your inner demons and defeat Khemadia.
[ES] Vences a tus demonios internos y derrotas a Khemadia.

[EN] ...

You have returned from your inner purgatory, and awakened to your true strength.

It is time for you to return to the mortal world and face the Black Dragon once more.

This is my gift, please take it.
Go, and bring peace back to the world...
[ES] ...

Has regresado de tu purgatorio interior y has despertado a tu verdadera fuerza.

Es hora de que regreses al mundo mortal y enfrentes al Dragón Negro una vez más.

Este es mi regalo, por favor tómalo.
Ve y devuélvele la paz al mundo...

[EN] The Black Dragon did major damage to the Veil.
But its threat is ended now.

I must restore the Veil.

No one will ever set foot in this place again, other than I, Mystel, the Goddess of Fate."Does this mean that...?"
[ES] El Dragón Negro causó un gran daño al Velo.
Pero su amenaza ha terminado ahora.

Debo restaurar el Velo.

Nadie volverá a poner un pie en este lugar, excepto yo, Mystel, la Diosa del Destino."Does this mean that...?"

[EN] Velika is safe. Velik... myself... we are safe as well.

But the device that the cultists were using...
I felt a dark energy from it that I've never experienced before...

We must keep a watchful eye out for their return.
[ES] Velika está a salvo. Velik... yo misma... estamos a salvo también.

Pero el dispositivo que los cultistas estaban usando...
Sentí una energía oscura proveniente de él que nunca antes había experimentado...

Debemos estar atentos a su regreso.

[EN] It is nice to see you again, .

I received a message from the Valkyon Federation. The city of Velika is planning a banquet, and they wanted me to deliver your invitation.
Halran will be there too. The banquet will be attended by numerous luminaries, as well as many of your old friends.

The invitation is enchanted to transport you to Velika. Just use the invitation when you're ready to go.
[ES] Es bueno verte de nuevo, .

Recibí un mensaje de la Valkyon Federation. La ciudad de Velika está planeando un banquete y querían que te entregara tu invitación.
Halran también estará allí. Al banquete asistirán numerosos luminarias, así como muchos de tus viejos amigos.

La invitación está encantada para transportarte a Velika. Solo usa la invitación cuando estés listo para ir.
